caption: The drawing features two views of a single human figure wearing traditional fringed clothing, depicted from the back (left) and from the front (right). The garments, including a long-sleeved top, pants, and a cap, are all rendered in shades of tan and brown and are decorated with zigzag-cut and fringed edges. The front view shows the figure holding a long object, possibly a tool or weapon, across the chest. Both arms and legs of the clothing have fringe accents running down their length. A bag with a blue base and white and red geometric patterns hangs on the figure’s left side in the rear view, resting against the hip. The figure’s facial features are depicted with minimal detail, and the skin is rendered in a pale tone. The background is an unadorned, light beige color. The artist’s signature, “Geo. J. File,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Frontiersman Doll
